events.title: wampa
events.description: Imagine John William's timeless music from Star Wars rebuilt as jazz electro-funk, not played for laughs but intricate, grooving and fun as hell! Sax and EWI running through a full effects chain, synth layers, and a rock-solid rhythm section propelling it all. It's a mix of Headhunters meets Vangelis meets Chick Corea. personnel: Jason Muscat [...]
